test_case_description: boundary:Validate plan inclusions boundary: plan with zero or no specific inclusions (e.g., no OTT, no ISD in plan).

test_steps.step: Login as a prepaid user with a plan that lacks certain inclusions (e.g., no OTT, no ISD benefits).
Tap the hamburger menu on the top-left corner of the home page.
Select 'My Active Services' from the menu.
test_steps.expected_output: 'My Active Services' screen is displayed with listed prepaid accounts.

test_steps.step: Tap on the relevant prepaid account to view its details.
Look for the 'View Pack Details' option in the account details page and tap it.
test_steps.expected_output: Current Plan page is displayed with plan details.

test_steps.step: Check on page for details related to OTT/ISD missing.
test_steps.expected_output: Plan details page either hides absent inclusions or displays a clear message indicating 'No OTT/ISD included', with UI remaining consistent and error-free.

test_case_description: Prepaid user navigates to usage details from Current Plan page and verifies usage statistics are displayed.

test_steps.step: Open Airtel Thanks app and log in with your prepaid number and OTP.
Tap hamburger menu on top-left corner.
Select your prepaid account from the list.

test_steps.expected_output: Current Plan page with plan balance information under usage appears.

test_steps.step: Verify plan balance and usages for data, call minutes,  and other inclusions are displayed.
test_steps.expected_output: Current data, calls and usage details are correctly shown to the user.

test_case_description: When viewing Current Plan, plan details (name, type, inclusions, validity, auto-renewal, OTT link if available) refresh and display the most up-to-date status upon navigation.

test_steps.step: Open Airtel Thanks mobile app and login using prepaid mobile number and OTP.
Tap the hamburger menu on the top-left.
Tap the prepaid account to view options.
test_steps.expected_output: Options for selected prepaid account are visible.
'Current Plan' page fetches and displays up-to-date plan details (plan name, type, validity, inclusions, auto-renewal, and OTT activation link if applicable).

test_steps.step: Click back  button to  navigate to 'home screen after login' and repeat steps 2-5.
test_steps.expected_output: 'Current Plan' page refreshes, displaying the latest available data from backend.
